description_en: Checks cloud service configurations. You can check all items or a specific item and verify whether an item is checked
description_zh: 执行云产品配置检查任务，支持全量检测或对单个检查项进行检查或验证
name: StartBaselineSecurityCheck

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值包括：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The type of the check task. Valid values:

check

verify
parameters.help_zh:
检查的任务类型。取值包括：

check：执行检测
verify：执行验证
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the check items.

To perform a check task on cloud service configurations, you must specify the ID of the check item. You can call the [DescribeRiskItemType](~~DescribeRiskItemType~~) operation to query the IDs of check items
parameters.help_zh:
检查项ID。

执行云产品配置检查任务，需要提供检查项的ID，该ID可调用[DescribeRiskItemType](~~DescribeRiskItemType~~)接口获取
parameters.name: item_ids

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
